summary.text: John Damoose is a Republican state senator from Michigan who represents District 37 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A documentary director and producer and author, he served in the Michigan House from 2021 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: John Damoose, also known as Ance, lives in Harbor Springs, Michigan, and earned a degree in political science from the University of Michigan in 1994.
His career experience includes working as a documentary director and producer, a book author, and executive director of Building America's Tomorrow.

Damoose represented District 107 in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2021 to 2023, succeeding Lee Chatfield, and he took office in the state Senate for District 37 on January 1, 2023, succeeding Wayne Schmidt.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Senate Appropriations Committee, the Education and Career Readiness Committee (as minority vice chair) and the Energy and Environment Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on August 4, 2026.
